II. Cloze Passage (Questions 28–32)

I live in a small neighbourhood in the suburbs. There are parks, shops, restaurants, and schools. My favourite place is the park because it is beautiful and peaceful. The streets are busier than the alleys. I like going to the cafe, but I dislike the streets because they are (28) ______ and crowded. My friend asks: “Shall we go to the park?” I answer: “Yes, (29) ______ go first, then we can visit the art gallery.” We also compare our neighbourhood with the city centre: it is (30) ______ and more peaceful. The schools are (31) ______ than the ones in the city. I enjoy walking around because it’s very (32) ______.

III. Reading Comprehension Passage (Questions 33–38)

"My neighbourhood is exciting. There are many parks and schools. Streets are busy but beautiful. I like visiting the sandy beaches nearby. Restaurants and shops are modern. Some streets are noisy, but overall it is peaceful. My friend’s neighbourhood is quieter than mine. I like my neighbourhood because it is great for outdoor activities."

SHORT WRITING

I. Rearrange the words to make complete sentences (Questions 39–41)

→

→

II. Rewrite the sentences without changing their meaning (Questions 42–46)

42. The streets are noisy.

→ I dislike the streets

43. Binh Minh is noisier than Long Son.

→ Long Son is

44. Shall we go to the restaurant?

→ Let’s

45. Let’s go to the park first.

→ Shall

46. There are many shops in my neighbourhood.

→ My neighbourhood
MINI REVIEW - KIẾN THỨC CẦN NHỚ UNIT 4

1. Key Vocabulary (Từ Vựng Trọng Tâm):

  • • Suburbs /'sʌbɜːbz/: Ngoại ô
  • • Peaceful /'piːsfl/: Yên bình
  • • Sandy beach: Bãi biển cát

2. Key Grammar (Ngữ Pháp Trọng Tâm):

  • • Comparative adjectives (So sánh hơn): Short adj + -er than (e.g. wider than, noisier than) / Long adj: more + adj + than (e.g. more modern than).
  • • Suggestions (Gợi ý): Shall we + V_bare? = Let's + V_bare.
